errors.text_span: 图表由两个嵌套的饼图构成
errors.evidence: The chart is not a nested pie chart. It is a single pie chart where one slice ('其他') is expanded or broken down into a second pie chart to show its components. 'Nested' implies one chart is physically inside another, which is not the structure here.

errors.text_span: 内层小饼图则进一步细分了“社交”类别下的子类别。
errors.evidence: The inner (right) pie chart does not break down the '社交' (Social) category. The connecting lines clearly show that it is a breakdown of the '其他' (Others) category from the main (left) pie chart, which accounts for 5.64%.
The color for the '其他' (Others) slice is a muted blue/grey, not orange. The '表情' (Expression) slice is orange-ish.
The color for the '身体动作' (Body Movements) slice is a light blue-green, not dark grey.

errors.text_span: 内层饼图位于“社交”类别内部，该类别在主饼图中占比为15.44%
errors.evidence: This statement repeats the fundamental error that the inner chart details the '社交' (Social) category. The inner chart details the '其他' (Others) category (5.64%). '社交' is a sub-category within the inner chart.
The chart shows two distinct categories: '战争' (War) at 0.6% and '争斗' (Struggle) at 15.1%. The description incorrectly assigns the value of '战争' to '斗争'.
The category '身体动作' (Body Movements) at 2.38% is part of the main (left) pie chart, not the inner (right) pie chart. This category is not present in the breakdown.

The category '生活工作' (Life/Work) is in the main chart with a value of 74.74%. The value 10.56% belongs to '生理活动' (Physiological Activities), also in the main chart. Neither of these categories is in the inner pie chart.
The description of the inner pie chart fails to mention two categories shown in the figure: '战争' (War) at 0.6% and '争斗' (Struggle) at 15.1%.

errors.text_span: 部分切片在视觉上被放大或偏移以突出显示，例如“生活工作”和“社交”类别。
errors.evidence: No slices in either pie chart are visually magnified or offset from their respective centers. This describes a visual feature that does not exist in the figure.

errors.text_span: （与主饼图中“社交”占比相同，可能为同一层级的再细分）
errors.evidence: This parenthetical comment is an unsubstantiated interpretation based on the incorrect premise that the inner chart is a breakdown of a '社交' category. It introduces speculation not supported by the figure.

errors.text_span: （与主饼图中“社交”比例一致，可能为重复标注）
errors.evidence: This is another speculative comment based on the incorrect understanding of the chart's structure. The description is trying to explain a discrepancy that only exists because of its own error.
